description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

description.zh: 用户UID。您可以通过DMS控制台右上角头像处查看您的UID。
description.en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You can view your UID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console.

description.zh: 用户ID，可通过调用接口[ListUsers](~~141938~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the user. You can call the [ListUsers](~~141938~~) operation to query the ID of the user.
